responsibility: This target header customizes the SPARC64 FreeBSD configuration. It defines FreeBSD/SPARC64 preprocessor builtins, linker and assembler specs, ABI type properties such as wchar_t and selectable 64- vs 128-bit long double, default target masks and code model for 64-bit V9 ELF, TLS flavor selection, and startup/endfile behavior needed to integrate the generic SPARC backend with the FreeBSD userland and linker conventions.
